messages:
anya: Quick synthesis from last week's customer calls + ask: propose an MVP for the Optimize Toolkit we can commit to for Q3. Core asks: batching advisor (per-route batch size + expected latency/cost delta), prefix/KV caching recommendations + API hints, quantization guidance (per-model profiles + expected perf/cost), and eval-triggered alerts for regressions. Need scope (must/should/nice), rough eng + ML estimates, and launch criteria. Thoughts?

sam: Ack. A couple clarifying q's — for batching do we start with static suggestions only or include adaptive autosizing? Also what are acceptable perf deltas (p50/p99) so we can size tests?

anya: Prefer static suggestions + ops hints for MVP. Autosize is a follow-up. Target: p50 impact <5ms, p99 <20ms on SLO routes; prioritize features that deliver >10% cost reduction for common workloads.

mike: Notes for eval alerts: baseline metrics we should track: accuracy/top-1 on labeled prompt-sets, embedding-similarity delta, and generation-quality regressions (BLEU/ROUGE-ish for structured tasks). Suggested thresholds: alert on >3% drop in top-1 or >0.1 increase in avg embedding distance vs baseline. Can prototype with existing eval infra.

jen: From CS: customers repeatedly asked for per-route explainability and rollback suggestions. They want an API to check model compatibility for 4-bit quant (known-good list) and a preview endpoint that runs a small prompt-set on quantized weights to show expected quality delta.

claire: UX ask: add a lightweight 'preview' panel in Console showing token-level latency delta and side-by-side sample outputs (orig vs quant/cached/batched). For alerts surface example prompts that triggered the signal and show a simple diff view.

tomas: SRE concerns: rollout must include canary to a dedicated pool + automatic fallback to a non-quantized variant if latency or error rates exceed thresholds. Also need throttles for batch-size increases to prevent sudden load spikes. Metrics must be exportable to Prometheus for on-prem customers.

alice: Data requirements: advisor signals need 90-day histograms of sequence length, tokens-per-generation, route concurrency, and percentiles of response sizes. We'll also need a low-overhead sampling pipeline for request contexts and eval label storage for pilot customers.

sam: Very rough eng estimates (initial sketch): static batching advisor + Console UI: 3-4 sprints (2 engs). Caching recommendation engine + gating API: 2-3 sprints (1.5 engs). Quant profile recommendations + preview pipeline: 3 sprints (1 eng + 1 ml infra). Eval-triggered alerts integration: 2 sprints (1 eng + 1 data). With overlap, cross-functional v1 ~6-8 sprints.

anya: Proposed must/should/nice breakdown: MUST: static batching advisor, caching recommendations, safe-quantization guardrails (known-good list + preview API), basic eval alerts + notification (Console + webhook). SHOULD: Console preview panel, sample-diff in alerts, per-route rollout automation. NICE: adaptive autosizing, on-the-fly quantization pipeline and per-request auto-tuning.

mike: For MVP alerts support two channels: Console and webhook for customer automation. We'll reuse eval runner but need a small rule engine to manage thresholds and suppress flapping.

jen: Pilot customers: SlackPilot (enterprise) is willing to test batching advisor + preview. RetailAI wants eval alerts + quant preview. Both can commit engineers for integration testing.

claire: I'll produce Console mocks and a micro-interaction flow by EOD Friday.

tomas: I'll draft a canary + fallback runbook and list exact metrics we need exported.

anya: Next steps: sam & mike to refine sprint plan and resource asks by Tue EOD; alice to produce dataset & telemetry requirements; jen to coordinate pilot signups; claire to post mocks; tomas to draft runbook. I'll consolidate into a PRD after that. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/optimize/toolkit/prd-draft (auto)

sam: ACK — will post a lane-level breakdown and propose owners this afternoon.

anya: Thanks everyone — booking a kickoff Thurs 9am to align on scope and acceptance criteria.
